modelInput.question: Using a demand and supply diagram, explain the effect of the drought on the equilibrium price and quantity of wheat. [4 marks]
modelInput.answer: The drought increases the amount of wheat available, so I have shifted supply right from S1 to S2. At the original price producers now offer more wheat than consumers want to buy, creating a surplus. Sellers reduce the price, and consumers buy more as they move down the unchanged demand curve. My new equilibrium therefore has a lower price and a higher quantity of wheat traded.
